name: Blockhaus 13, Colmenar del Arroyo
story: After the Battle of Brunete the western front of Madrid settled along the Perales valley. In late 1938 the Nationalist 71st Division began a line of large concrete blockhouses here; Blockhaus 13, built by the 2nd Company of the 7th Sapper Battalion, was the only one completed. Designed to withstand heavy artillery and aerial bombs, it has four domed machine-gun nests linked by a central corridor, an inner courtyard and a cistern. Unusually well preserved, it was declared a Bien de Interés Cultural in 2019.
see: A near-intact reinforced-concrete blockhouse with four circular firing nests.
plan: Signposted near the M-510 between Navalagamella and Colmenar del Arroyo; short walk from the road; free.
